design.algorithm: global BM25 (Task-69 exact) -> selected sources by first appearance -> per-source BM25 (allowed indices, global IDF) -> round-robin merge by (within_source_rank, source_candidate_rank) up to top_k - fills_kept; metadata fills kept only for sources with zero lexical candidates (tail, max 3)

phase8_pre_registered_criteria.C_selection_limited: unit metrics improve materially but evidence ceiling gain < +0.02 and Ev0 reduction < 3
phase8_pre_registered_criteria.B_source_limited: residual unit misses are source-miss / corpus-absence / zero lexical overlap (candidate miss), not within-source rank depth
phase8_pre_registered_criteria.D_cost_limited: within-source retrieval runtime > 2x R0 global runtime, or R8 context median > 1.2x R7 context median

phase5_known_cases.note: UNKNOWN — expected unit not present in corpus (corpus absence)
UNKNOWN — no expected units recorded in frozen benchmark
expected source not in selected set (cannot anchor within-source)

not_measured: generation e2e scores for R8/R9: NOT_RUN in this script (retrieval-only phases; BASE generation decided separately in report)
graded passage relevance: NOT_MEASURED (no graded qrels exist)

post_hoc_sensitivity.purpose: isolate merge-policy effects (M2 score-order vs R8 round-robin) and split residual ranking-miss into within-source depth vs merge-blocking; NOT a pre-registered config, NOT used for the primary verdict
post_hoc_sensitivity.M2_definition: top_k = global BM25 score order filtered to the Task-69 selected sources + R8 fills policy (fills kept only for zero-lexical sources); k5/500 and k10/1000 scored like R0/R7
